title: FX249 an environment without a network

cards.title: No load balancer to pay for
cards.text: The two apps move to an environment on no network of our own, about R370 a month saved.

cards.title: A group of their own
cards.text: rg-louis-agent-za holds the new environment and the apps, under the same names.

cards.title: The shared parts stay
cards.text: Registry, vault, share and identities stay in rg-puls-za, with rights given across.

cards.title: Old beside new
cards.text: The old apps serve until the new ones answer with their certificates; then DNS moves.

cards.title: Then the old goes
cards.text: The old apps, environment, load balancer, IP and puls-vnet are deleted, by you.
